## About
YORK Appliances & HVACR was founded by Fernando May in Highland Park, California. You can find us on N Figueroa St in Los Angeles.
On the home side we fix refrigerators, washers, dryers, stoves, dishwashers, wall ovens and cooktops. We also handle furnaces, condensers, thermostats, heat pumps, mini split systems and swamp coolers.
For restaurants, bars and markets, we sell, repair and install commercial refrigeration, from soda and beer refrigerators to ice machines and salad preparation tables.

## Services
- Appliance repair: Professional appliance repair services.
- Heating and air conditioning: Heating and air conditioning service.
- Commercial refrigeration: Selling, repairing and installing commercial refrigeration equipment.

## FAQ
Q: How soon will I hear back if I use the contact form?
A: If a reply is needed, you will hear back within 1 to 3 hours, Monday through Friday.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We are open Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.
